fact: At the 28 April 2026 launch of national interoperability, the Digital Governance Unit (UGD) said it develops and operates Rahaka, the national data-exchange system already running at EDBM, CNaPS, Instat, the justice ministry and the tax directorate, with World Bank Prodigy support.
title: Madagascar: Administration - Mise en place d'un guichet unique en ligne
